items.english: Outside the door, grown dark before they knew it, there was the sound of hard wind and rain. It was a storm.

The parent and child had gathered at the table under the dim electric light hanging by the wall of the narrow room, about to take their evening meal. Both father and mother were still truly young. And the child was a round and fat baby girl, just able to stand by holding to the table.
notes: Kept 'parent and child' and 'father and mother' literal to hold the exterior distance before the narration slides to 'the man' and 'the woman.' Table renders 卓 with ruby テーブル.

items.english: Neither the man nor the woman had yet a single wrinkle in the face. But in the hollowed, kind-looking eyes in the shadow of the man's thick eyebrows a dull color of tiredness could be seen. And about the color of the woman's dark hair and her slight shoulders could be seen a deeper tiredness as if beaten down, and a drowsy peace.
The day had ended. The sorrow and suffering of the day were about to flow into the peace of the night. And smiling in silence, they poured their eyes upon everything of the child.
notes: Kept 'everything of the child' literal for すべて to hold the all/everything repetition, though stiff in English.

items.english: The child, standing unsteadily, with fat short hands round as balls, was trying to sweep at everything on the table, leaving no gap and far too fast. So smiling, they set everything, the tea bowls and the earthen teapot and the aluminium pot, down under the table. On the table there was left only the small spoon the child held and one small plate.
notes: Vessels kept plain in English without exoticizing: tea bowls, earthen teapot, aluminium pot.

items.english: But the child gave a noisy cry full of small joy and banged spoon and plate down on the table.

data.say: Drafted p1-p6 as the crowded comic supper that opens the storm frame, keeping exterior labels and repetitions.
